first editor of the Mothers\' Union Journal

Daughter of Admiral Sir Thomas Sabine-Pasley, 2nd Bt., she married (1877) Henry Jenkyns, barrister, parliamentary counsel to the Treasury.

He was knighted in 1892 when she became Lady Jenkyns/.
